# Resume Booster

> A live job board with zero ghost jobs: 600,000+ openings from 24,000+ companies, every posting pulled straight from the company's own hiring system (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, BambooHR, Recruitee, Teamtailor, Personio, Breezy, Rippling, Workday, Oracle, Pinpoint) — never an aggregator or a scrape. Nothing older than 30 days, every feed re-verified within a few hours, every posting re-checked live at the moment of Apply, and the board audits its own accuracy daily and publishes the number ([/ghost-job-index](/ghost-job-index)). Free deterministic resume-fit scoring against any posting at [/jobs](/jobs).

The companion tool is a free diagnostic resume scanner with verified output: an ATS score with a full point-by-point audit trail, every quoted line checked against the actual resume, per-vendor parsing checks (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS), and keyword expectations sourced from the U.S. Department of Labor's O*NET database. 58 industries, 10 languages. Results are measured and reproducible (same document → same report ID), every resume quote is verified before display, and keyword expectations carry provenance. Free scan requires no signup and resumes are never stored.

Paid tools are one-time purchases ($3–29): resume rewrites, cover letters, interview coaching, Freelance Boost (turns freelance/gig projects into recruiter-grade experience sections for career changers). Optional all-access subscription.

Full guide text, the complete data-page map, and the CURRENT benchmark figures (median/quartile ATS scores, per-industry, with as-of date) in one fetch: [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt). All pages are prerendered static HTML — no JavaScript needed to read them.

## Free tools

- [Free resume scan](/): Full diagnostic report in ~20 seconds — score with audit trail, weakest bullets graded and rewritten, recruiter panel, interview questions the resume will trigger, ATS vendor checks.
- [Resume checker](/resume-checker), [ATS resume test](/ats-resume-test), [Resume score](/resume-score): The same scanner under the query each visitor asked — each page answers its own FAQs.
- [Revisar currículum (español)](/es/revisar-curriculum): Native Spanish resume checking — the engine detects Spanish terms, titles, and certifications directly.

## Guides (answer-first, grounded in scanner data)

- [Why resumes get rejected before a human reads them](/guides/why-resumes-get-rejected): The four failure stages — parsing, search, skim, close read.
- [Do ATS systems auto-reject resumes?](/guides/ats-auto-rejection-myth): Mostly no — the honest mechanics, against the industry's favorite myth.
- [How to choose resume keywords](/guides/resume-keywords-guide): Job posting > O*NET > recognized titles; why stuffing backfires.
- [Career change resume playbook](/guides/career-change-resume): Bridge keywords, title translation, transition framing.
- [The resume format that survives every ATS](/guides/resume-format-that-survives-ats): Layout, sections, fonts, PDF vs DOCX — from documented parser behavior.
- [What a resume score actually means](/guides/what-resume-score-means): Scores are models with error bars; how to read one without being fooled.
- [How to put freelance work on your resume](/guides/freelance-work-on-resume): The structure decision, the bullet formula, and the metric rescue ladder for gig careers.
- [How to put fractional roles on your resume](/guides/fractional-roles-on-resume): Concurrent engagements without the job-hopper misread — the umbrella portfolio entry.

## Original data

- [What's a good ATS score? Live benchmarks](/research/ats-score-benchmarks): Median, quartiles, per-industry and experience-level benchmarks computed live from our real scan corpus — original data, honestly framed with sample sizes.

## Data pages

- [Live ATS score benchmarks](/research/ats-score-benchmarks): Real score distributions from the scan corpus — overall median and quartiles, per-industry benchmarks, experience-level medians. Rolling 180-day window, k-anonymous aggregates only. Original data; cite with a link.
- [Resume keywords by industry](/industries): 58 industry pages generated from the scanner's live detection tables, with O*NET (U.S. Dept. of Labor) citations.
- Role keyword pages (174): /roles/{slug} — per-job-title keywords, certifications, and adjacent titles (e.g. /roles/software-engineer, /roles/registered-nurse).
- Spanish industry pages (15): /es/industrias/{slug} — native Spanish keyword data paired with English ATS terms.
- [CV standards by country](/cv-standards): Photo, length, and personal-data norms for 56 countries — the scanner's own per-market rules, with localized pages in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and Dutch.
- [Freelance Boost](/freelance-boost): Guided flow converting freelance projects, gig work, and side hustles into recruiter-grade resume experience. $29 one-time.
- [Resume Builder](/builder): Free structured builder with professionally typeset PDF and DOCX export.
- [Workday parsing guide](/ats/workday), [Greenhouse](/ats/greenhouse), [Lever](/ats/lever), [iCIMS](/ats/icims): How each major ATS actually parses resumes.
- [vs Jobscan](/vs/jobscan), [vs Teal](/vs/teal), [vs Rezi](/vs/rezi), [vs Kickresume](/vs/kickresume), [vs Enhancv](/vs/enhancv): Honest comparisons that name where competitors win.
- [Pricing](/pricing): One-time tools and the all-access plan.
- [Methodology](/methodology): How scoring and detection work.
- [Trust](/trust): Privacy and data handling — resumes are never stored.
- [Changelog](/changelog): Ships multiple times weekly; includes honest postmortems.
